terms:Adjuster fusion.def: The eternal union of the Thought Adjuster with the human soul. It usually occurs on the mansion worlds, and afterward the eternal career is no longer at risk.

terms:adjutant mind-spirits.def: The seven circuits through which the Mother Spirit works at the level of mind: the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, and wisdom.

terms:agondonter.def: The name for ascenders from quarantined worlds who believed without seeing and persevered in isolation.

terms:Amadon.def: The Andonite who stood with Van against the rebellion to the end; the outstanding human hero of the Lucifer rebellion.

terms:Ancients of Days.def: Rulers of Trinity origin who govern the superuniverses, three for each superuniverse.

terms:Andon and Fonta.def: The first human twins, born to the Primates about a million years ago; the actual parents of all mankind.

terms:Andonites.def: The primitive race made up of the descendants of Andon and Fonta; the aborigines of Urantia.

terms:Angona.def: A huge system of bodies that passed near our sun about 4.5 billion years ago and, by its gravity, drew out the material of the solar system's planets.

terms:ascending pilgrim.def: The name for a mortal survivor who has been cleared for the progressive ascent toward Paradise.

terms:ascending son.def: A being born on an evolutionary world who attains sonship through experience; human beings belong here.

terms:atonement doctrine.def: The idea that someone must pay the price of sin in our place before God's wrath can be satisfied. The Urantia Book calls it incompatible with the Father whom Jesus revealed.

terms:attribute.def: A trait that shows what kind of Being God is. Papers 2 and 3 treat infinity, immutability, justice, mercy, omnipresence, omniscience, omnipotence and others.

terms:autorevelation.def: Truth made clear in a person's mind through the work of the indwelling Adjuster.

terms:Badonan tribes.def: Descendants of the Andonites living in the highlands of northwestern India, among whom the Sangik family was born.

terms:bestowal.def: The act of a descending Son who is born in the likeness of a creature and lives that life in person.

terms:bestowal parents.def: Joseph and Mary, the earthly parents of Jesus. Gabriel chose them as an ordinary couple with an ideal combination of qualities.

terms:bestowal Son.def: A Paradise Son who bestows himself on an evolutionary world. To Urantia the Creator Son Michael came in person.

terms:biologic uplifters.def: Another name for the Material Sons and Daughters. They share their bloodline with the evolutionary races to raise humanity in body and mind.

terms:Bright and Morning Star.def: The chief executive of a local universe, the first being created jointly by the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit. In Nebadon, Gabriel of Salvington.

terms:brotherhood of man.def: The teaching that all people are children of the same Father and so brothers and sisters, shown in loving service.

terms:Conjoint Actor.def: Another name for the Infinite Spirit, meaning the one who carries out in action the united will of the Father and the Son.

terms:corporeal staff (the one hundred).def: One hundred ascendant citizens of Jerusem who came with the Planetary Prince, took on material bodies, and taught mankind. Forty remained loyal in the rebellion.

terms:Corps of the Finality.def: The corps into which ascending mortals who reach Paradise are mustered, beginning their eternal service.

terms:Creator Son.def: A Paradise Son of God who makes and rules a local universe. Michael of Nebadon, the Creator Son of our universe, came to this world as Jesus.

terms:cult.def: A system of rites and symbols that preserves religious feeling and loyalty. It began with the ghost cult and grew into the sacraments.

terms:Dalamatia.def: The headquarters city founded by the Planetary Prince Caligastia in Mesopotamia and mankind's first school; it sank beneath the sea after the rebellion.

terms:dark gravity bodies.def: Enormous bodies that encircle Havona in two belts and balance the gravity of Paradise. They neither reflect nor absorb light.

terms:dawn mammals.def: The first stage of man's direct animal ancestry, which appeared by sudden mutation from the lemur type.

terms:default.def: Failure to keep a covenant and trust. What Adam and Eve did was judged a default, not the sin of rebellion.

terms:descending Son.def: A Son of God created divine from the beginning who comes down to serve the lower worlds.

terms:dispensation.def: A stretch of planetary history opened when a Son of God arrives on a world. A normal world passes through seven ages.

terms:Divine Counselor.def: A high personality of Trinity origin serving in superuniverse administration. Divine Counselors wrote the Foreword, Paper 1, and several other papers.

terms:Divinington.def: One of the Father's worlds around Paradise and the home of the Thought Adjusters. After death the Adjuster goes there for a time.

terms:Edentia.def: Headquarters of the constellation of Norlatiadek, where on seventy training worlds ascenders learn the group ethics of living with other beings.

terms:emergency Son.def: A Son bestowed specially in a crisis not provided for in the normal plan. Machiventa Melchizedek is an example.

terms:epochal revelation.def: A great revelation given by celestial beings for an entire age. Urantia has received five.

terms:Eternal Son.def: The second Person of the Paradise Trinity, who fully shares the spiritual nature of the Universal Father.

terms:evil.def: The misadaptation of plans and the maladjustment of techniques. It can arise even from good motives and is distinct from sin, which is deliberate transgression.

terms:evolutionary religion.def: Humanity's circuitous search for truth, beginning in fear of the unknown.

terms:faith.def: The level belief reaches when it actually governs the way a person lives. Beliefs can be held by a group, but faith grows only in the individual heart.

terms:fatherhood of God.def: The truth that God is the loving Father of every person, the first pillar of Jesus' gospel.

terms:First Source and Center.def: The name for God used throughout the universe, meaning that all things come from Him and revolve around Him.

terms:first-stage spirit.def: The first spirit status, gained on completing the morontia course of the local universe, just before departing for the training worlds of the superuniverse.

terms:Foreword.def: The guide to the meaning of terms at the front of the book (Paper 0), written by a Divine Counselor of Orvonton.

terms:fusion.def: The eternal union of a surviving human soul with the Thought Adjuster. Once fused, the two can never again be separated.

terms:Gabriel vs. Lucifer.def: The case pending before the superuniverse court on Uversa that deals with the final disposition of the rebel leaders.

terms:Garden of Eden.def: The garden prepared by Van and Amadon on a peninsula of the eastern Mediterranean, the first headquarters of Adam and Eve. It later sank beneath the sea.

terms:God-consciousness.def: The intellectual capacity for knowing God, the first sign of the presence of the indwelling Adjuster.

terms:gospel of the kingdom.def: Jesus' own message: the fatherhood of God and the sonship-brotherhood of men.

terms:grand universe.def: The presently organized and inhabited creation, made up of the central universe Havona and the seven superuniverses. It holds about seven trillion inhabitable worlds.

terms:great circuit of love.def: The circle in which love from the Father passes through each person to his or her brothers and on to the Supreme (117:6.10).

terms:guardian of destiny.def: A seraphic guardian personally assigned to one human being, who walks with that person through life.

terms:Havona.def: The central universe of a billion perfect worlds surrounding Paradise. It did not evolve but was created perfect from the beginning.

terms:Holy Spirit.def: In this book, the spiritual presence of the local universe Mother Spirit. It takes the worshiping mind into the spirit circuits.

terms:Immanuel.def: A high being who represents the Paradise Trinity in Nebadon. He looked after the universe during Michael's bestowal and gave him his charge before it began.

terms:immutability.def: The unchanging nature and purpose of God. Divine immutability does not imply immobility.

terms:incarnation.def: A divine being being born in a human body. How it happens remains an eternal mystery.

terms:indwelling.def: Living within. The Adjuster indwells the human mind, not the brain.

terms:Infinite Spirit.def: The third Person of the Paradise Trinity, also called the Conjoint Actor, and the source of all mind.

terms:inhabited world.def: A planet where mortals with will live. Urantia is the 606th inhabited world of Satania.

terms:institutionalized religion.def: Living religious experience hardened into a focus on organization and creeds. Paper 99 calls sectarianism its disease.

terms:Jerusem.def: Capital of the local system of Satania, where ascenders who finish the mansion worlds become citizens and learn representative government.

terms:Joshua ben Joseph.def: Joshua the son of Joseph, the Hebrew name The Urantia Book uses for Jesus.

terms:kingdom of heaven.def: The kingdom found wherever the spirit of God teaches and leads the human soul. It is entered now by faith and fulfilled in heaven.

terms:Lanonandek Sons.def: The order of local universe Sons who serve as System Sovereigns and Planetary Princes. Because they come close to mortals, they also run a greater risk of going astray.

terms:Life Carriers.def: Local universe Sons who design life, plant it on planets, and remain for long ages to foster its development.

terms:life implantation.def: The planting of the original life patterns on a planet by the Life Carriers. On Urantia it took place in three places at once, 550 million years ago.

terms:life-modification world.def: A planet on which experiments in changing and improving the standard life designs are permitted. Urantia is such a world, so its life is unique.

terms:light and life.def: The settled final age an evolutionary world reaches after all its dispensations; it widens in seven stages from a planet to a superuniverse.

terms:local universe.def: A unit of about ten million worlds made and ruled by one Creator Son. Our local universe is Nebadon.

terms:Lucifer manifesto.def: Lucifer's declaration of rebellion on Jerusem, also called the Declaration of Liberty. It attacked the reality of the Father, Michael's government, and the ascension plan.

terms:Lucifer rebellion.def: The rebellion raised about two hundred thousand years ago by Lucifer, System Sovereign of Satania, against the rule of Michael.

terms:Machiventa Melchizedek.def: One of the twelve Melchizedeks in charge of Urantia. He appeared at Salem in human form 1,973 years before the birth of Jesus and brought the third epochal revelation.

terms:Magisterial Son.def: A Paradise Son of the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit, called an Avonal, who judges planetary ages and sometimes bestows himself.

terms:Mansion World Teachers.def: Glorified cherubim and sanobim, once helpers of the guardian angels, who teach ascenders in the schools of thinking, feeling, and doing.

terms:mansion worlds.def: The seven satellites circling the first transition world of Jerusem, where survivors first awaken and are trained after death.

terms:Master Spirit.def: One of the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit; the seven Master Spirits express the seven associations of the three Deities, and each oversees one superuniverse.

terms:master universe.def: The whole universe: Paradise-Havona, the seven superuniverses, and the four outer space levels still being organized.

terms:Material Son and Daughter.def: The Adam and Eve who come to a planet to uplift its races biologically.

terms:Melchizedek receivers.def: The twelve Melchizedeks who took charge of Urantia after the rebellion of the Planetary Prince.

terms:Melchizedek Sons.def: The eldest-son order of the local universe. They lead the education of ascenders and step in as "emergency Sons" on worlds in crisis.

terms:Michael of Nebadon.def: The Creator Son who made Nebadon and lived on Urantia as Jesus of Nazareth. To our universe he is, to all practical intents and purposes, God.

terms:midwayer.def: A being between humans and angels who has long lived on this planet. The midwayers wrote Part IV, the life of Jesus.

terms:Mighty Messenger.def: A former ascendant mortal who reached Paradise, was embraced by the Trinity, and now serves in a superuniverse government.

terms:mind gravity.def: The pull that draws all minds and all true intellectual values to the Infinite Spirit.

terms:ministering spirit.def: The angels, children of the Infinite Spirit, who teach and help ascending creatures.

terms:Monmatia.def: The name for our sun and its family of planets, that is, the solar system.

terms:morontia.def: The intermediate level of reality between matter and spirit; after death a person awakens in a morontia body.

terms:morontia appearance.def: A time when the risen Jesus became visible to human eyes. There were nineteen in the forty days before his ascension.

terms:morontia companions.def: Children of the local universe Mother Spirit who welcome, guide, and share leisure with ascenders on the mansion worlds.

terms:morontia resurrection.def: Jesus' rising from the tomb not in the flesh but in the likeness of a morontia personality, like those who are resurrected on the mansion worlds.

terms:mortal.def: A being who faces death, that is, a human being; one of the book's basic terms.

terms:mota.def: Morontia wisdom, higher than human philosophy. On the first mansion world it is studied side by side with sayings of human philosophy.

terms:Mystery Monitor.def: Another name for the Thought Adjuster, the fragment of the Father that indwells the human mind.

terms:Nebadon.def: The name of the local universe we belong to; a young universe growing toward a hundred constellations, ten thousand systems, and ten million inhabited worlds.

terms:new commandment.def: Jesus' final charge, "That you love one another even as I have loved you." It was given not as a duty but as the joy of friendship.

terms:new teacher.def: A name for the Spirit of Truth poured out at Pentecost. It fosters truth and keeps believers from feeling orphaned.

terms:Nodites.def: Descendants of the rebel members of the Planetary Prince's staff, named after their first leader, Nod. They are the eighth race of Urantia.

terms:omnipresence.def: Being present everywhere at the same time (3:1.1).

terms:omniscience / omnipotence.def: Knowing all things and holding all power. Omnipotence does not mean the power to do the ungodlike.

terms:Onagar.def: The great teacher who brought peace to the declining Andonite tribes and led them together in worship of the Breath Giver.

terms:Orvonton.def: The seventh superuniverse, to which we belong. Its headquarters is Uversa, and it is called a universe demonstration of love and mercy.

terms:outer space levels.def: The four concentric levels of space beyond the seven superuniverses, still in the process of being organized.

terms:pair marriage.def: The union of one man and one woman to establish a home of the highest social order; the culmination of the evolution of marriage.

terms:Paradise.def: The eternal Isle at the center of all things, where the Universal Father dwells.

terms:Paradise Trinity.def: The eternal Deity union of the three persons, Father, Son, and Spirit. It is not a gathering of three Gods but a single union of Deity.

terms:Pentecost.def: The name of a Jewish festival. In this book it refers to the day of the ascension, when the Spirit of Truth was poured out upon all believers.

terms:personality.def: What makes a being self-conscious, able to choose, and able to share fellowship with other personalities. Only the Universal Father bestows it.

terms:personality circuit.def: The circuit through which the Universal Father makes direct contact with every personality. The worship of all personalities reaches the Father through it.

terms:Personalized Adjuster.def: A Thought Adjuster that has finished its mission and gained an independent personality. Jesus' Adjuster was personalized at his baptism in the Jordan and became chief of the Adjusters of Nebadon.

terms:Planetary Prince.def: The being entrusted with the spiritual government of a planet. Caligastia, the Planetary Prince of Urantia, joined the rebellion.

terms:power directors.def: Beings who, once energy responds to gravity, gather the energies of space and shape them into suns and planets. They work before the Creator Son arrives.

terms:Primates.def: The direct ancestors that came from the mid-mammals and gave birth to the first humans. In this book the word is used in this narrow sense, for man's direct ancestors only.

terms:Providence.def: The interlocking work of celestial beings and divine spirits for the honor of God and the spiritual progress of His children.

terms:quarantine.def: The measure that cut the planets involved in the rebellion off from the universe circuits. Urantia is a quarantined world.

terms:religion about Jesus.def: A religion that makes the risen and glorified Christ the object of worship; it grew up after Pentecost through the apostles and Paul.

terms:religion of authority.def: Religion that leans on the authority of tradition and records and demands uniformity of belief. It tends to divide people and harden into lifeless creeds.

terms:religion of Jesus.def: The personal faith Jesus himself lived: doing the Father's will and serving one's fellows.

terms:religion of the spirit.def: Religion grounded not in authority or creed but in the personal experience of knowing God. It asks only unity of experience and allows diversity of belief.

terms:remembrance supper.def: The rite of bread and cup that Jesus established in the upper room on his last night; the believer's symbolic rendezvous with Michael.

terms:resurrection halls.def: The temple of personality assembly at the center of the first mansion world, where Adjuster and soul reunite and the survivor awakens.

terms:revelatory religion.def: Religion propounded by the real spiritual world in response to human longing, marked by belief in a Deity of final value and in survival after death.

terms:Salvington.def: The headquarters (capital) of the local universe of Nebadon, an architectural sphere where Michael and the Universe Mother Spirit reside.

terms:Sangik races.def: The six colored races born about half a million years ago into one Sangik family of the Badonan tribes: the red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and indigo races.

terms:Satania.def: The local system to which Urantia belongs; its capital is Jerusem, and it now has 619 inhabited worlds.

terms:savior.def: A name for Jesus, not as one who paid a ransom but as one whose life and death made the way of salvation more clear and certain.

terms:second garden.def: The new home Adam and Eve founded by the Euphrates after the default. There the Sethite priests carried on their teachings.

terms:seraphim.def: Angels created by the Universe Mother Spirit, the ministering spirits of time who help mortals most closely. They work in pairs.

terms:seventh bestowal.def: Michael's final bestowal: the life he lived on Urantia as the mortal man Jesus of Nazareth, following the will of the Universal Father.

terms:sleeping survivors.def: Those without a personal guardian angel, who rest unconscious until the end of an age and then awaken together as a group.

terms:Son of Man.def: The title Jesus chose for himself. As a youth he read it in the Book of Enoch and took it as the name of his mission.

terms:soul.def: The morontia reality born and growing out of the relationship between the mind and the indwelling Adjuster; it survives death.

terms:Source and Center.def: The origin from which all things come and to which they return. The Father, Son, and Spirit are called the First, Second, and Third Source and Center.

terms:spirit ascension.def: The risen Jesus' return to the Father at the close of his morontia career, on the Mount of Olives on May 18, A.D. 30.

terms:spirit gravity.def: The pull that draws all spiritual realities and values to the Eternal Son. It responds to quality, not quantity, and does not weaken with distance.

terms:Spirit of Truth.def: The spirit poured out by the Creator Son, which helps people recognize truth.

terms:spirit of wisdom.def: The seventh of the seven adjutant mind-spirits, which turns worship away from natural objects toward the God of nature.

terms:spirit of worship.def: The sixth of the seven adjutant mind-spirits, which constantly stirred the urge to worship even in primitive minds.

terms:spiritual unity.def: Oneness that comes not from thinking alike but from each person's awareness of the Father's indwelling spirit and the shared desire to do His will.

terms:supernaphim / seconaphim / seraphi.def: The angelic hosts of the central universe, the superuniverses, and the local universes respectively; together they form an unbroken chain of ministry.

terms:superuniverse.def: One of the seven great creations evolving in time and space, each holding about a trillion inhabitable worlds.

terms:Supreme Being.def: The God who grows through experience together with the universes of time and space. Standing alone, He is called "the Supreme."

terms:System Sovereign.def: The Lanonandek Son who governs a local system of about a thousand worlds. Lucifer was the System Sovereign of Satania.

terms:Thought Adjuster.def: A fragment of the Father's spirit that God sends to dwell in the human mind. The Foreword calls it "a fragment of God."

terms:Thought Changer.def: The name given to the Adjuster from its arrival until a person is about twenty years old.

terms:Thought Controller.def: The name given to the Adjuster from the age of discretion (about forty) until deliverance from the flesh.

terms:Trinitized Son.def: A Son of God who has passed through a trinitizing experience or has been embraced by the Trinity.

terms:Trinity Teacher Son.def: A Paradise Son of the Father, Son, and Spirit, called a Daynal, who teaches throughout the universes.

terms:Universal Father.def: The God of all creation and the First Source and Center. It is the name The Urantia Book uses most often for God.

terms:Universe Mother Spirit.def: The daughter of the Infinite Spirit who creates and governs a local universe together with the Creator Son. She is also called the Divine Minister and the Creative Spirit.

terms:Urantia.def: The name by which our planet, the earth, is known in the universe. The title The Urantia Book comes from it.

terms:Urantia Papers.def: The fifth epochal revelation: not the work of a single personality but a composite presentation by many beings.

terms:Van.def: Chairman of the supreme council of the one hundred, who denounced Caligastia's rebellion and remained loyal to the end.

terms:violet race.def: The race made up of the descendants of Adam and Eve, also called the Adamites. Blending with the Nodites and others, they later became the Andites.

terms:Vorondadek Sons.def: The order of local universe Sons who govern the constellations; also called Constellation Fathers.

terms:will creature.def: An intelligent being able to choose and decide for itself. Human beings are will creatures.

terms:World of the Cross.def: The name by which neighboring planets know Urantia, because the Creator Son was crucified here.

terms:worship.def: A response offered to the Universal Father that asks nothing for oneself and simply delights in God as He is.
